red_river.case: In re Red River Talc LLC, S.D. Tex. No. 24-90505
red_river.outcome: denied confirmation + dismissed Mar 31 2025 (Judge Lopez); J&J will not appeal, returns to tort, ~$7B reserves reversed
red_river.meaning: third Two-Step failure, two jurisdictions; strategy dead by announcement

korea_zinc.event: Dec 2025 FTC field raid (Dec 17-19) on Young Poong/YPC
korea_zinc.mechanism: YPC created Mar (100% equity), 5.26M Korea Zinc shares (25.42%) contributed in-kind -> new circular link YoungPoong>KoreaZinc>SunMetal>YoungPoong
korea_zinc.law: MRFTA mutual-investment tier bar on new circular links; 2006 review -> 2007 amendments (holding companies); KLRI e-law English text exists
korea_zinc.meaning: reform-bypass live in real time: new subsidiary defeats old ban

grade: trade press + court records (Red River); Korean press + KFTC primary-adjacent (Zinc)
